name: Não se vá!
source:
On top of a building at night, a man plans to end his life, you must prevent this unbalanced person from committing this end, will you be able to save him from himself?

[From [url=https://ivo-the-hedgehog.itch.io/no-se-v] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
夜晚，一名男子站在大楼顶端，打算结束生命。你必须阻止这个失控的人完成最后一步。你能把他从自己手中救回来吗？

[来源：[url=https://ivo-the-hedgehog.itch.io/no-se-v]itch.io[/url]]
